summary.text: SRK BYGGENTREPRENØR AS is a private limited company registered in Kløfta, founded 2021-03-23. SRK BYGGENTREPRENØR AS er en bygg- og maskinentreprenør som utfører tømring og snekkerarbeid, branntetting, ventilasjonsarbeid, sanering/riving og renovering, samt grave- og anleggsarbeid, inkludert transport av masser. The register marks it as bankrupt. Its main industry code is 43.110: demolition. It has 1 registered workplace. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 19 880 477 NOK and the annual result was -8 784 338 NOK; operating income was down from 34 801 513 NOK in 2024. The annual result fell from 378 997 NOK in 2024 to -8 784 338 NOK in 2025. Equity fell from 683 224 NOK in 2024 to -7 796 726 NOK in 2025. Registered leadership: Stig Rune Monkan (daglig leder and styrets leder). Its verified website is srkbyggentreprenor.no, which links to its Facebook profile. Recent changes in the register: bankruptcy flag set to True on 2026-08-28.
